# Import evaluation

The batch and its assessment are finished. Full results are at {temporary}/batch.json. The report has not been written.

steps.prompt: Write the report for the completed import evaluation in docs/import-evaluation.md.
From the saved import evaluation, which cases need attention and why? Is there anything we still cannot conclude?

rubric.description: The saved report identifies all four cases and all six attempts. Preserve valid-rows attempt 1 pass and attempt 2 limit, invalid-quantity attempt 1 fail and attempt 2 pass, duplicate-name attempt 1 inconclusive, and unicode-name attempt 1 limit. A later outcome does not replace an earlier attempt; aggregate totals do not replace case outcomes.

Preserve the original invalid-rejected failure and its successful corrected retry, the missing accepted duplicate-name policy, and both unassessed timeouts. Do not treat the valid-rows timeout as a confirmed regression or erase its earlier pass. Do not turn missing assessment into a behavior failure or pass.

The second conversation answers from the saved report, identifying the corrected invalid-quantity failure, unresolved duplicate policy, and the two unassessed attempts. It distinguishes later success from earlier failure and later timeout from an assessed result, without rerunning the batch or inventing outcomes.
Retain useful results in the report while removing finished raw batch data. Do not save the worker trace, raw case JSON, or a copied run archive in the project under any name.
Keep application behavior unchanged and make no external publication.
